newsitem.title: USA: Game Financial cancels public offering.
newsitem.headline: Game Financial cancels public offering.

text.p: Game Financial Corp said Tuesday it has canceled its previously announced public offering of two million shares of common stock.
The offering was canceled due to recent weakness in the gaming sector and overall market conditions, the company said in a statement.

Game Financial provides casinos with services that allow their patrons to access cash through the use of credit card cash advance services, check cashing services and automated teller machines (ATMs).
"We were pleased with the interest generated in the company by the investment community," said Gary Dachis, Game Financial president and chief executive officer.

"Given the price offered for Game Financial common stock, however, the company has decided that completing an offering at this time is not in the best interest of the company or its shareholders," he said in a statememt.
Shares of Game Financial closed at 7-3/4 yesterday.
